entries.text: `--datagen-backend native` generates TPC-H and TPC-DS data (TPC-DS at integer scale factors of 1 or more) with the benchbox-datagen library from the new `native-datagen` extra, writes Parquet directly from the library, and records `generator_backend` and the library version in the data manifest. Anything the library does not support fails with an error instead of falling back to the bundled generators.

Native TPC-DS data has the 24 benchmark tables and no `dbgen_version` table; `dbgen_version` is a `dsdgen` artefact holding a generation timestamp, and the manifest lists it under `excluded_tables` so validation does not expect it.
